rationale: VRT has gapped up 16.5% on heavy relative volume (5.65x) and is now consolidating near the midpoint of today's wide range, sitting essentially at VWAP ($236.16) and the 9-EMA ($236.03) with no clear directional momentum — the last five 1-minute candles show choppy, overlapping price action without a decisive breakout or breakdown.
